name: Jaysmito101/TerraForge3D
description: A cross-platform procedural terrain generation and texturing tool featuring a node editor with 40+ nodes, hydraulic and wind erosion algorithms, and GLSL shader export. Fully free and open-source as a standalone application.
score_rationale: Feature-rich standalone terrain tool rivaling commercial products, with node-based editing and multiple erosion simulations.
summary: Cross-platform terrain tool with node editor, 40+ nodes, and hydraulic/wind erosion simulation.
